# Opening

Every term in this book is marked in one index, and no term is marked in two
chapters, so no printed level path puts two chapters' sort keys in question.
Within a chapter a term may be marked twice — four.qmd marks the two ends of a
range that way.

A term filed in the first declared index: [Aardvark]{.index}.

A term filed in the index the THIRD chapter's marker places, so this chapter
holds a mark for an index it does not place: [Cardamom]{.index index="beta"}.

A term filed in the index no marker in this book names, so this chapter holds
a mark for an index nobody asked for: [Gantry]{.index index="gamma"}.

The marker below names no index, so it places the first declared one. Four
chapters come after it, which is what makes this book's index sections depend
on what an earlier render recorded.
